_comment: The eager (index-*.js) chunk's gzip ceiling, in BYTES. This file is the single
source of truth: it used to be prose in a docs/BACKLOG.md row, raised and
recorded by the same person, with no mechanical check in either direction.
It was raised twice in two PRs before anyone could notice.
MEASURE THE SHIPPING BUILD. The bundle must be built with VITE_API_LIVE=true
(what infra/docker/Dockerfile.api sets). A build without it is ~860 B LARGER
and is not what ships — that discrepancy already made one reviewer report a
wrong figure. scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs asserts the mode rather than
trusting the caller.
Raising this number is a deliberate act: say why in the PR body, and expect to
justify it, which is the whole point of it living somewhere a diff can see.
WHAT IS COUNTED (#323): the whole EAGER GRAPH -- the entry <script type=
'module'> plus every <link rel='modulepreload'>, read out of the built
dist/index.html. It used to be 'the largest dist/assets/index-*.js', which
is the same number today but stops being the same the moment the build
splits: with manualChunks configured, the old form measured 19,594 B while
the browser eagerly fetched 65,284 B (measured -- it under-reported by
45,690 B and showed headroom that did not exist).
NOT counted, deliberately: CSS (a separate ~8.9 kB gzip that no version of
this gate has ever included), and lazily-imported chunks, which are absent
from index.html by construction.
The KEY NAME below is load-bearing. Mistyping or renaming it used to make
the gate read `undefined`, compare `gz > undefined` (false), and print
'bundle budget OK ... headroom NaN B' for a bundle of any size, exit 0.
It is now validated as a positive integer and a bad value FAILS the build.
